query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple iPhone 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple iPhone 2026

annotations.title: Buy iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone **directly from Apple**—online or at an Apple Store. As of now, Apple’s current lineup includes **iPhone 17 Pro / Pro Max**, **iPhone Air**, **iPhone 17**, and the newer entry-level **iPhone 17e**. Apple’s U.S. shop lists iPhone 17 Pro from **$1,099**, iPhone Air from **$999**, iPhone 17 from **$799**, and iPhone 17e from **$599**. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_iphone?utm_source=openai))

**Best places to buy in the U.S.:**
- **Apple Store / Apple.com** — best for unlocked options, trade-in, Apple Card financing, in-store pickup, and setup help. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/go/buy_iphone?utm_source=openai))
- **Carriers** — AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, and Boost Mobile are available as carrier options through Apple, often with installment/trade-in promos. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-17-pro?utm_source=openai))
- **Major retailers** — Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target, and Amazon may sell current iPhones, but availability and promos vary.

If you want the **top/latest flagship**, look at **iPhone 17 Pro or iPhone 17 Pro Max**. If you want the newest iPhone at a lower price, consider **iPhone 17e**.
